title: Five Below Lifts Outlook, Aims to Ramp Up Appeal to Gen Alpha
summary: Five Below Inc. shares rose over 8% in postmarket trading on Wednesday after the retailer lifted its full-year outlook, citing the addition of new stores and the popularity of its budget-friendly merchandise among Gen Alpha and Gen Z shoppers.

title: Petco Services, Auto-Ship Sales Grow as Turnaround Continues
summary: Petco Health & Wellness Co. shares rose as much as 14% in postmarket trading Wednesday after the pet supply retailer reported profit above Wall Street expectations and comparable sales grew for the second straight quarter after a year of declines.
